data.one_liner: A JWT decoder to extract headers, payload, expiration date, and issued date.
data.what_it_does: Decodes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to extract the header, payload, expiration date, and issued date. It also provides a check to see if the token is expired.
use_when: You need to read claims and expiration data from a JWT on the client side
You want a simple utility function to decode tokens without verification overhead
avoid_when: You need to cryptographically verify or sign JWTs on the client side
You require complex backend token generation and management
strengths: Simple and straightforward usage with a single main function
Extracts expiration and issued dates out of the box
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Limited to decoding and does not support token generation or cryptographic signature verification
Not documented for advanced security customization
